Configure a Local Air-Gapped OpenAI-Compatible Runtime (llama.cpp / vLLM)

Source: R/runtime.R
runtime_openai_local.Rd

Creates a runtime backend targeting a strictly local loopback OpenAI-compatible server (/chat/completions), such as llama-server (llama.cpp) or vLLM. Strictly rejects any non-loopback remote URL (such as external cloud APIs or LAN hosts) and disables HTTP proxies on every request.

Usage

runtime_openai_local(
  model,
  base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1",
  api_key = "airgap-local",
  temperature = 0,
  seed = 42L,
  top_p = 1,
  max_tokens = 1024L,
  timeout = 120,
  container_spec = NULL,
  model_digest = NULL,
  transport = NULL
)

Arguments

model

Character scalar local model identifier served by llama.cpp or vLLM.

base_url

Character scalar loopback base URL (default "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1"). Non-loopback URLs trigger an immediate airgap_isolation_error.

api_key

Local dummy bearer token (default "airgap-local").

temperature

Numeric decoding temperature (default 0).

seed

Integer random seed (default 42L).

top_p

Numeric nucleus sampling parameter (default 1).

max_tokens

Integer maximum generated tokens (default 1024L).

timeout

Numeric per-request timeout in seconds (default 120).

container_spec

Optional airgap_container_spec() associated with this runtime.

model_digest

Optional pinned SHA-256 digest of the model weights.

transport

Optional custom httr2 mock transport function for offline HTTP testing.

Value

An S3 object of class c("airgap_runtime_openai_local", "airgap_runtime").

Examples

rt <- runtime_openai_local("qwen2.5-7b-instruct", base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1")
print(rt)
#> <airgap_runtime:openai_local>
#>   Model:       qwen2.5-7b-instruct
#>   Endpoint:    http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 (loopback)
#>   Temperature: 0 | Seed: 42
